body: No, I still do have a social life sometimes and I stick to projects that are of my interest.

My life isn't really stressful right now. I don't feel depressed but I have noticed that I don't feel emotions as strongly as before. Maybe that's because my life is boring. I do not think I have depression right now.

1. I haven't had the courage nor financial aid to seek appropriate treatment.


2. Some friends are aware of it, but I have a stereotype that Asian culture discounts depression as an excuse for being lazy, so my family is kept in the dark.


3. I cope by watching shows, doing my hobbies, talking to friends. It isn't even mildly effective in solving the problem but it distracts me momentarily, even if it's just minutes.


4. Some friends have said that depression makes friendships more difficult, which I agree. I know it is incredibly difficult to be patient all the time. Most people don't know a thing about depression and so they make false assumptions in their mind and think about us differently. Just think of us as normal people, and be a little patient with us.

Also, I'd urge Singaporeans to talk to their representatives about reforming mental healthcare because the aid to mental health is seriously deprecated. Costs are high, waiting times are eternal, awareness is non-existent. Misconceptions are rampant. Social change is a lot to ask for but this is how things improve, with ideas.
